requirements.text: The System shall decode the documentation header of every installed-pack language solely from the syntax tokens and field spellings that the matching profile declares.
The System shall extract the documentation header from line-prefixed comments, delimited comment blocks, and docstring quotes according to the header syntax the profile declares.
The System shall accept an ordered list of accepted spellings for each documentation field and shall name the first accepted spelling when it reports a missing field.

The System shall decode no content for a header line that begins with the declared tag sigil yet matches no field spelling, and shall append unlabeled header prose to the field the profile designates.
The System shall check each installed pack's golden example file against that pack's own documentation checks, and a golden example that fails shall fail the test suite.

While a pack governs only the documentation header of its language, the System shall keep unit-documentation checks in their existing pass and shall suppress only the duplicated header labels from it.
